scene_description: A small tiled bedroom viewed from an elevated angle, with a bed in the foreground, white shelving and a cabinet along the back wall, two floor lamps, an open door, and a white furniture piece at right.
initial_target_observations: The initial reconstruction shows a dark doorway with only a narrow pale vertical edge; the broad open door leaf visible in the reference is absent from the foreground. The bed and right-hand furniture remain largely unobstructed.
candidate_target_observations: The candidate adds a tall, pale paneled door leaf projecting into the room and occluding part of the right-hand furniture and background. Its vertical silhouette is closer to the reference, but its panel arrangement, apparent width, placement and lower edge differ; it also overlaps the bed area differently in the image.
geometric_plausibility_observations: The candidate door reads as a flat open leaf, though the image alone does not establish its hinge attachment or whether it intersects other objects. The shelves, cabinet, lamps and bed have broadly plausible silhouettes. Compared with the reference, the candidate bed is larger in frame, the left lamp is farther inward, and the right furniture is simplified.
new_visible_defects: The candidate door has a simplified two-panel face rather than the reference's more detailed wood-toned paneling; its lower silhouette and occlusion do not match the reference precisely.
other_changes: The reference has warmer, stronger lamp illumination, visible wood grain, a mottled floor covering and more nuanced materials. Both reconstructions are flatter and grayer, with simplified furniture and lighting. The candidate and initial have broadly similar viewpoint and room arrangement apart from the door region.

evidence.description: A light wood paneled door leaf extends into the foreground, partially obscuring the room and right side.
A dark opening and narrow pale edge appear where the broad door leaf would be.
A broad pale paneled leaf now projects into view and obscures some of the right side.
Shelving, cabinet and two lamps appear with warm illumination and more detailed surface shading.
Simplified white shelving, cabinet and lamps retain the main arrangement but have flatter materials and cooler lighting.

uncertainty: Judgments use only the three supplied RGB views. Door attachment, actual contact or collision, hidden geometry and behavior cannot be determined from these images. Partial reflects the visible remaining silhouette, placement and material differences, not a claim about hidden construction.
